title: b7z9.88.c: Rust - pin expired-signature -> Baseline on the DIO RX path (R-06-307, receive.rs:713-715 untested)
description: Child of b7z9.88: the expiry gate in rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/receive.rs:709-715 (expired or unassessable clock -> DioRootSigOutcome::Baseline, never Reject) has NO test coverage. Deliverable: an rpl_stack test (rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/tests.rs) driving a root-signed DIO whose signature option carries an EXPIRED payload expiry, with set_wall_clock_unix(:163) set past it, asserting the DIO is admitted as BASELINE (treated as unsigned per R-06-307) and NOT rejected. Fixtures exist: root_sig.rs mod tests (:428) holds VALID_COSE_SIGN1 (expiry 1735689600, already past any current clock) + VALID_PUBKEY + decode_hex helper (pub(crate)); the option can be built via message.rs RootDioSignature::write_to (exists, no producer needed for the RX-side test - construct the option bytes directly); stack setup mirrors the rpl_stack tests.rs patterns (fresh_manager-style). Also pin the unassessable-clock case (wall_clock_unix = None -> Baseline). CAUTION: the sibling test three_rpl_stacks_send_leaf_dao_via_preferred_parent is RED pending the ehcn unicast-DIO decision - the new test must not depend on that path.
close_reason: Already complete on main (worker4 verify, no code change needed). The R-06-307 expired/unassessable-clock -> Baseline gate coverage the bead asks for already exists and passes in rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/tests.rs: (1) expired_root_signature_admitted_as_baseline_not_rejected (:2755) — expired payload expiry, wall clock set past it, asserted Baseline not Reject, including a replayed redelivery; (2) expiry_equal_now_root_signature_admitted_as_baseline_not_rejected (:2822) — now == expiry boundary degrades to Baseline; (3) clockless_root_signature_admitted_as_baseline_not_rejected (:2883) — unassessable clock (no set_wall_clock_unix) -> Baseline. Fixtures use root_sig::tests::vector_cose()/vector_pubkey() + RootDioSignature::write_to, and the harness pins the root key and joins first (not dependent on the red three_rpl_stacks path, per the bead's CAUTION). Verify on main (CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/home/mark/Cache/cargo-target): cargo test -p lichen-node --lib baseline_not_rejected = 3 passed, 0 failed. No files touched, no review passes applicable. Landed by another worker mid-flight (tests predate my claim); closing as done.
